scripts._prepare: `tsc` is part of prepare because `dist` is a BUILD INPUT for the web workspace, not just a publish artifact: web/src/lib/offline.ts imports this package's deploy scripts and rocketh config to run them in the browser, and every one of those export paths resolves into dist. Without it a fresh clone or worktree fails `web check` with module-resolution errors that say nothing about this package. It is `tsc` and NOT `pnpm typescript`, which also type-checks test/js: an install must not be gated on a suite's types, and a descendant branch of this template whose own tests do not type-check yet would otherwise be unable to run `pnpm i` at all. Building dist is what an install owes; checking the tests is what `pnpm typescript` is for.
scripts.:deploy:dev+export: expand-vars pnpm hardhat --network $MODE deploy --no-compile --skip-prompts && expand-vars rocketh-export -e $MODE
scripts.fork:deploy: ldenv pnpm @=HARDHAT_FORK=@@MODE compile --build-profile production ~~ pnpm hardhat --network fork deploy --report-gas-used ~~ @@
scripts.deploy:watch: wait-on ./generated && ldenv -m localhost pnpm as-soon -w generated -w deploy pnpm run deploy:dev @@MODE @@
scripts.test:watch: wait-on ./generated && as-soon -w generated -w test hardhat --network test test --no-compile
scripts._lint: test/solidity is not listed: this repo has no Solidity tests left (delegation's went into @etherplay/delegation), and slippy fails on a pattern that matches nothing. hardhat.config still points at the directory, so put the glob back with the first .t.sol that lands there.
scripts.docgen: ldenv -m default pnpm run deploy @@MODE --save-deployments true --skip-prompts ~~ pnpm rocketh-doc -e @@MODE --except-suffix _Implementation,_Proxy,_Router,_Route ~~ @@
scripts.deploy: pnpm compile --build-profile production && ldenv hardhat --network @@MODE deploy @@
